title: Party-parity per-event per-AC verdict row
description: ONE ROW of the per-constituency verdict CSV produced by the per-event Compare-Aggregator (backend/yen_gov/canonical/recon/event_aggregator.py). Created by PR-S-TN-AE2026 of the 2026-06-10 electoral-data-quality + party-catalogue plan. The verdict CSV lives under datasets/ephemeral/party-parity/state=<slug>/<event>/<sha>/verdict.csv per CLAUDE.md section 3 ephemeral tier; the first run for a (state, event) is committed (Q3 commit policy) as the audit-trail. Verdict semantics (Hans section 10 + Fowler machine-decidable per plan section 0.5 ESCALATE #2): VERIFIED iff n_oracles_present >= 2 AND all present oracles agree on (winner_party_id, winner_candidate_name); DISPUTED iff n_oracles_present >= 2 AND at least one oracle disagrees on either dim; UNVERIFIED iff n_oracles_present < 2.

x-changelog.description: Initial schema for the Tier-C per-event per-constituency verdict row (PR-S-TN-AE2026 of TODO/20260610-electoral-data-quality-and-party-catalogue-plan.md). 16 fields per the brief: state (kebab-slug, required), event (ECI event id, required), constituency_no (1-based ECI eci_no, required integer), constituency_name (representative publisher name, required), n_oracles_present (count of distinct external_scope values in the AC group, required integer), n_oracles_agreeing_party (count of oracles agreeing on the modal winner_party_id, required integer), n_oracles_agreeing_candidate (count of oracles agreeing on the modal winner_candidate_name after punctuation normalisation, required integer), yen_gov_winner_party_id (the canonical surface winner party_id; pulled from the yen-gov-elections oracle when present, else first-alphabetic scope, required), yen_gov_winner_candidate_name (the canonical surface winner candidate name, required), yen_gov_winner_votes (nullable integer; publisher-reported total), other_sources (pipe-delimited 'scope:party_id:candidate:votes' for every non-primary oracle, sorted alphabetically by scope, required), party_id_alliance (empty when alliance not yet curated for this event - the citizen-UI 'alliance not yet curated' badge signal per Q6, required), verdict_party (VERIFIED|DISPUTED|UNVERIFIED enum, required), verdict_candidate (same enum, required), verdict (combined enum: VERIFIED iff both dims VERIFIED; UNVERIFIED iff either dim UNVERIFIED; DISPUTED otherwise; required), curator_note (free-text disposition, nullable), curator_source_id (FK to datasets/data/entities/source.csv.source_id for the curator's authoritative source, nullable). Holy Law #9 enforcement is a CURATOR rule, not an aggregator rule - the aggregator surfaces ECI disagreements as DISPUTED and the curator dispositions via curator_note + curator_source_id. Wired into recon/event_aggregator.py ConstituencyVerdictRow + write_event_verdict_csv. Schema is reference-only (verdict CSVs live under datasets/ephemeral/, not walked by Tier-B).

state.description: State slug from datasets/data/entities/geo.csv (e.g. 'tamil-nadu', 'west-bengal'). CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

event.description: ECI event id registered in backend/yen_gov/sources/eci/events.py (e.g. 'AcGenMay2026'). CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

constituency_no.description: 1-based ECI eci_no within the state. CSV-column-contract dtype: integer, nullable: false.

constituency_name.description: Publisher constituency name (representative; pulled from yen-gov-elections when present, else first-alphabetic scope). CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

n_oracles_present.description: Count of distinct external_scope values present for this (state, event, constituency_no) group. CSV-column-contract dtype: integer, nullable: false.

n_oracles_agreeing_party.description: Count of oracles whose winner_party_id matches the modal value in the group. CSV-column-contract dtype: integer, nullable: false.

n_oracles_agreeing_candidate.description: Count of oracles whose winner_candidate_name matches the modal value after punctuation normalisation (event_aggregator._normalise_name). CSV-column-contract dtype: integer, nullable: false.

yen_gov_winner_party_id.description: Canonical party_id of the surface winner. Pulled from the yen-gov-elections oracle when present in the group; falls back to first-alphabetic scope otherwise. MAY be 'parties.IN.UNK' per CLAUDE.md section 10. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

yen_gov_winner_candidate_name.description: Candidate name of the surface winner, carried verbatim from the primary oracle. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

yen_gov_winner_votes.description: Publisher-reported total votes for the surface winner. Nullable. CSV-column-contract dtype: integer, nullable: true.

other_sources.description: Pipe-delimited 'scope:party_id:candidate:votes' for every non-primary oracle in the group, sorted alphabetically by scope. Empty when n_oracles_present == 1. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false (empty string is valid).

party_id_alliance.description: Alliance label looked up via (yen_gov_winner_party_id, event) against datasets/data/entities/party_alliances.csv. Empty when alliance not yet curated for this event - the citizen-UI 'alliance not yet curated' badge signal per Q6. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false (empty string is valid).

verdict_party.description: Verdict on winner_party_id agreement across present oracles. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

verdict_candidate.description: Verdict on winner_candidate_name agreement (after punctuation normalisation) across present oracles. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

verdict.description: Combined verdict. VERIFIED iff both party and candidate dims VERIFIED; UNVERIFIED iff either dim UNVERIFIED; DISPUTED otherwise. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

curator_note.description: Free-text disposition recorded by the curator script (e.g. 'ECI Statement 10 wins per Holy Law #9; thecont1 mis-spelled party'). Empty for auto-generated rows. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: true.

curator_source_id.description: FK to datasets/data/entities/source.csv.source_id naming the authoritative source for the curator's disposition. Empty for auto-generated rows. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: true.
